_about: PROVISIONAL gold data for the quiz-retrieval benchmark. Machine-drafted from the extracted text on 2026-10-11 by Claude Code; NOT human-reviewed. Kept outside git (unpublished manuscript). anchors = exact phrases (after normalisation: lowercase, markdown ** and _ removed, whitespace collapsed) that a supporting chunk must contain.

concepts.concept: Definition of the protein-sequence twilight zone
concepts.query: What sequence identity range defines the protein-sequence twilight zone?

concepts.concept: The four PLMs evaluated
concepts.query: Which protein language models are evaluated in the study?
anchors: esm-1b, esm-2, prott5, and prostt5 can

concepts.concept: Mean pooling produces one D-dimensional vector per protein
concepts.query: How are residue-level embeddings turned into a sequence-level representation?
concepts.answer: Mean pooling across the sequence length

concepts.concept: ESM-1b architecture: 33 layers, ~650M parameters, 1,280-dim
concepts.query: How many layers and parameters does ESM-1b have?

concepts.concept: Sequences longer than 1,022 residues are split into overlapping windows for ESM models
concepts.query: How are sequences longer than 1,022 residues handled by ESM-1b?
concepts.answer: Divided into overlapping windows, embedded separately and recombined

concepts.concept: ESM-2 variant esm2_t36_3B_UR50D, 36 layers, 2,560-dim, layer 33
concepts.query: Which transformer layer are ESM-2 representations taken from?

concepts.concept: ProtT5 uses only the encoder, full 32-bit precision, no sliding window
concepts.query: Does ProtT5 need a sliding-window procedure for long sequences?
concepts.answer: No, it processes long sequences without any sliding window

concepts.concept: ProstT5 structure-aware pretraining with Foldseek 3Di tokens; <AA2fold> control token
concepts.query: What structural representation is used in ProstT5 pretraining?
anchors: 3di tokens, and the model learns bidirectional

concepts.concept: No 3Di tokens or coordinates are supplied at inference
concepts.query: Are structural tokens supplied to ProstT5 at inference time in this study?
concepts.answer: No; it is sequence-based at inference
anchors: no 3di tokens or structural coordinates are supplied

concepts.concept: RBF bandwidth is the median pairwise Euclidean distance per model
concepts.query: How is the RBF kernel bandwidth chosen?
concepts.answer: Median pairwise Euclidean distance over all benchmark pairs for that model
anchors: set to the median pairwise euclidean distance

concepts.concept: Cosine is the only metric computed on normalised vectors
concepts.query: Which similarity metric is computed on normalised vectors?
anchors: cosine similarity is the only metric computed on normalised vectors

concepts.concept: PISCES: 20,466 pairs from 3,500 X-ray structures, filtered to 20,445
concepts.query: How many protein pairs remain in the final benchmark after filtering?

concepts.concept: BLASTP log-transformed E-value is the baseline score
concepts.query: What score is used for the BLASTP baseline?
anchors: logtransformed e-value is used as the primary baseline

concepts.concept: TMmin = smaller of the two directional TM-scores
concepts.query: What is TMmin?
concepts.answer: The smaller of the two directional TM-scores from TM-align
anchors: as the smaller of the two scores

concepts.concept: TMmin >= 0.5 defines the structurally similar (positive) class for ROC
concepts.query: What TMmin cutoff defines structurally similar pairs?
anchors: are therefore treated as the positive, structurally similar class

concepts.concept: Symmetric length ratio and the 0.5 split for length imbalance
concepts.query: How is sequence-length imbalance measured?
concepts.answer: Shorter length divided by longer length; split at 0.5
anchors: dividing the length of the shorter sequence by that of the longer sequence

concepts.concept: Embedding-generation time measured on H100 GPU nodes
concepts.query: On what hardware was embedding-generation time measured?
anchors: measured on the h100 gpu nodes

concepts.section: 3.1 Effect of PLMs and Similarity Metrics
concepts.concept: ProstT5 with cosine achieves the highest Spearman rho = 0.676
concepts.query: Which model and metric achieve the highest Spearman correlation with TMmin?

concepts.section: 3.1 Effect of PLMs and Similarity Metrics
concepts.concept: ProstT5 improves on ProtT5 by 0.119, attributed to structure-aware pretraining
concepts.query: By how much does ProstT5 improve over ProtT5 with cosine similarity?
anchors: with cosine similarity), from which prostt5 inherits

concepts.section: 3.1 Effect of PLMs and Similarity Metrics
concepts.concept: ESM-2 Euclidean-derived similarity drops to 0.166 and dot product to 0.044
concepts.query: How do Euclidean and dot-product similarity perform for ESM-2?

concepts.section: 3.1 Effect of PLMs and Similarity Metrics
concepts.concept: Cosine-similarity range: ESM models compressed to ~0.85-1.00; ProtT5 0-1; ProstT5 0.25-1.00
concepts.query: Why do ESM-1b and ESM-2 have limited dynamic range in cosine similarity?

concepts.section: 3.2.1 Overall Performance on the PISCES Dataset
concepts.concept: BLASTP reaches rho = 0.393 and fails for 1,410 pairs
concepts.query: For how many protein pairs does BLASTP fail?

concepts.concept: In the 0-10% bin ProstT5 reaches 0.561 while BLASTP is nearly uninformative (0.019)
concepts.query: How does BLASTP perform in the 0-10% sequence identity interval?

concepts.concept: At 20-30% identity BLASTP (0.726) outperforms ESM-1b (0.591) and ProtT5 (0.689)
concepts.query: Which PLMs does BLASTP outperform at 20-30% sequence identity?

concepts.concept: ROC AUC: ProstT5 0.831, ESM-2 0.806, ProtT5 0.766, ESM-1b 0.744, BLASTP 0.681
concepts.query: What AUC does ProstT5 achieve for separating similar from dissimilar folds?

concepts.concept: 8,998 positive and 11,447 negative pairs at TMmin = 0.5
concepts.query: How many positive and negative pairs are there at the 0.5 threshold?

concepts.section: 3.3 Effect of Pairwise Sequence Length Ratio
concepts.concept: ESM-1b improves most for length-balanced pairs (+0.152, 0.294 to 0.446)
concepts.query: Which model is most affected by sequence-length imbalance?

concepts.concept: Storage: ProtT5 3.08 GB, ProstT5 3.20 GB, ESM-1b 3.85 GB, ESM-2 7.71 GB
concepts.query: How much storage do ESM-2 residue-level embeddings require?

concepts.concept: ESM-1b is fastest; ESM-2 most expensive and scales steeply with length
concepts.query: Which model is fastest at generating residue-level embeddings?
anchors: esm-1b is the fastest model overall

concepts.concept: Limitation: global mean pooling and a single representation layer
concepts.query: What limitation of the study do the authors acknowledge?
concepts.answer: Use of global mean pooling and a single representation layer
